achievements.name: The Auto Shop
achievements.description: Make contact with Oppy and plan your first route into the Zone from her Auto Shop.

achievements.name: Into the Wilderness
achievements.description: Install the Zone Scanner above the Auto Shop.

achievements.name: Investigate the Zone
achievements.description: Return to the Auto Shop after scanning five Anomalies or resources.

achievements.name: A Leap of Faith
achievements.description: Successfully test Oppy's theory and return to her Auto Shop.

achievements.name: Stabilizing the Route
achievements.description: Activate the Zone Stabilizers in the Outer Zone and escape back to the Auto Shop.

achievements.name: The Mid-Zone Crossing
achievements.description: Gain access to the Mid-Zone and escape from there to the Auto Shop.

achievements.name: Hack the Planet!
achievements.description: Find Oppy's secret hideaway in the Auto Shop and deliver the hard drive she stashed there to Francis and Tobias.

achievements.name: The Visions
achievements.description: Uncover some of the Zone's history in the Mid-Zone, then escape back to the Auto Shop.

achievements.name: The Red Meadow Records
achievements.description: Return to the Auto Shop after recovering data ARDA hid in the Red Meadow Research Facility.

achievements.name: The Deep Zone Crossing
achievements.description: Gain access to the Deep-Zone and escape from there to the Auto Shop.

achievements.name: The Anomaly Barricade
achievements.description: Overcharge the car's ARC Device and escape back to the Auto Shop.

achievements.name: The End of the Road
achievements.description: Return from the Well.

achievements.name: Along for the Ride
achievements.description: Equip the cryptid bobblehead item during the final mission, 'The Well', and escape back to the Auto Shop.

achievements.name: Long Haul
achievements.description: Drive an exceptional distance

achievements.name: Patent Pending
achievements.description: Invent something new after installing the Zone Scanner

achievements.name: Garage Barrage
achievements.description: Upgrade the Auto Shop into its prime

achievements.name: DIY Expert
achievements.description: Unlock quite a few things in the Fabrication Station

achievements.name: DIY Master
achievements.description: Unlock not everything, but really quite a lot of things in the Fabrication Station

achievements.name: ARDA Record-Keeper
achievements.description: Discover 300 Logbook entries

achievements.name: ARDA Lorekeeper
achievements.description: Discover 600 Logbook entries

achievements.name: Great Scott!
achievements.description: Reach 88mph

achievements.name: Scientific Pursuit
achievements.description: Scan an Anomaly while the storm is approaching

achievements.name: The Eye of the Storm
achievements.description: Escape through a Gateway after the storm has completely collapsed.

achievements.name: Car Of Theseus
achievements.description: Replace all of your car's original doors, panels, wheels and engine so none remain the ones you started with.

achievements.name: Fully Outfitted
achievements.description: Equip or install something in every possible slot on the car

achievements.name: Packrat
achievements.description: Load enough items into your car to fill 150 inventory grid slots.

achievements.name: Personal Methods of Creative Expression are Highly Encouraged
achievements.description: Fully decorate your car by equipping one of each kind of cosmetic item, and applying a paint or decal to installed car parts in every possible slot

achievements.name: Fly Homeward
achievements.description: Escape through a Gateway while the car's wheels are airborne

achievements.name: Streets Ahead
achievements.description: Complete a run with at least seven junctions

achievements.name: Juiced Up
achievements.description: Complete a run with at least two junctions, and with twice the anchor charge necessary to escape through the Gateway

achievements.name: Running on Empty
achievements.description: Complete a run with at least two junctions, and with the car always having a low or empty fuel tank

achievements.name: It Would Take a Miracle
achievements.description: Complete a run with at least four junctions, and without breaking or removing any car parts

achievements.name: With the Top Down
achievements.description: Complete a run with at least three junctions, and without any panels, doors, or bumpers on the car at any point

achievements.name: No Parking
achievements.description: Complete a run with at least three junctions, and without the car ever being in park

achievements.name: Driver's Ed Dropout
achievements.description: Forget to put the car in drive before hitting the gas, twenty times.

achievements.name: Lumberjack
achievements.description: Destroy 1,000 trees

achievements.name: They Weren't Using It
achievements.description: Liberate and equip a part from an abandoned car

achievements.name: Renewable Power
achievements.description: Fully charge a car battery from under 50% using only natural energy sources

achievements.name: Just Walk it Off
achievements.description: Get electrocuted, acid-burned, and physically hurt all within a minute

achievements.name: Et tu?
achievements.description: Get hit hard by your car

achievements.name: Graverobber
achievements.description: Discover your Remnant Ghost from a previous death, and retrieve any lost items or equipment.

achievements.name: Watch Out for Hop-ons!
achievements.description: Drive several miles with a Bunny on your car

achievements.name: Nothing Personnel, Zone
achievements.description: Kick a Tourist, Tour Bus, or Ticking Tumbler Anomaly.

achievements.name: Sleight of Hand
achievements.description: Distract an Anomaly with a light source

achievements.name: Certified Mechanic
achievements.description: Fix six status effects on the same car component

achievements.name: Car Whisperer
achievements.description: Diagnose and cure a Quirk.

achievements.name: Troubleshooting
achievements.description: Give your car a few swift kicks.

achievements.name: I Don’t Know What I Expected
achievements.description: Deconstruct a resource

achievements.name: Where We're Going, We Don't Need Roads
achievements.description: While driving, remain airborne for six seconds
